_note: The maximum amount not chargeable to income-tax for every individual other than one of Sl. No. 2 or 3, a Hindu undivided family, an association of persons or body of individuals, or an artificial juridical person — "Rs. 2,50,000" (s.2(2)(a), p.2), "₹ 250000" (s.3(2)(a), p.10), read with the net agricultural income for the rates (partial integration; W-258, D-778). FA 2026 s.2(2)(a) (TY 2025-26) and s.3(2)(a) (TY 2026-27): where the person "has … any net agricultural income exceeding five thousand rupees [₹ 5000], in addition to the total income, and the total income exceeds the maximum amount not chargeable to income-tax as specified in column C … the net agricultural income shall be taken into account, only for the purpose of charging income-tax in respect of the total income"; (b) Z = X – Y, X the tax on the aggregate income (total income + net agricultural income) and Y the tax on "the net agricultural income increased by a sum as specified in column C", both at the ladder's rates. The cap is column C; the ₹5,000 is the DeclaredAmountAbove condition (exceeding, so ₹5,000 itself does not integrate). "Total income" in the test and in the aggregate is total income less the income charged at special rates, as ITR-2 Part B-TI rows 13 – 15 read it (owner's ruling W-258 C4a). Its conditions are RATE-SLAB-FIRST-SCHEDULE's, so it holds wherever that ladder does. One version from 2025-04-01, open-ended like the slab rows; the two years' Tables state the same amount. Advance tax follows through tax.netpayable (s.3(14), pp.27 – 29).
